datasets.name: BPTypesDataSet
datasets.sql:
select id, typedesc
  from creditsmgr.cm_bp_types
union
select 0, ' Hamısı'
  from dual
order by id

datasets.name: DistrictsDataSet
datasets.sql:
select id, name
  from smart.otrasli
 where id>160
union
select 0, ' Hamısı'
  from dual
order by name

datasets.name: VillagesDataSet
datasets.sql:
select id, name
  from smart.nalog
 where districtid = :DISTRICT_ID
union
select 0, ' Hamısı'
  from dual
order by name

datasets.name: CustomersDataSet
datasets.sql:
select *
  from smart.customers
 where op_id = uid
   and nalog_kod = :VILLAGEID
--   and otrasl = :DISTRICTID

datasets.name: BPPurposesDataSet
datasets.sql:
select id, purposedesc
  from creditsmgr.cm_bp_purposes
union
select 0, ' Hamısı'
  from dual
 order by purposedesc

datasets.name: ExportDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   P.ID 
 , U.NAME as OWNER
 , C.NAME as BOOROWER
 , V.VALU_NAME as CURRENCY
 , P.INITIALAMOUNT 
 , P.CREDITLINEAMOUNT 
 , P.ANNUALYINTERESTRATE 
 , P.ANNUALYOVERDUERATE
 , P.ANNUALYPENALTYRATE 
 , P.DATEOFCONCLUSION 
 , P.DATEOFGRANT 
 , P.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT 
 , P.DUEDATELASTCONTRACT
 , P.CLOSEDATE 
 , P.NUMBEROFCREDIT 
 , P.PURPOSEOFCREDIT 
 , P.CUSTOMERTYPE 
 , T.TYPEDESC  as CREDITTYPE
 , P.USRGROUP 
 , B.NAME as BRANCH
FROM
   CREDITSMGR.CM_PORTFOLIO P
 , SMART.CUSTOMERS C
 , SMART.AVALUTE V
 , CREDITSMGR.CM_BP_TYPES T
 , CREDITSMGR.CM_USERS U
 , SMART.FILIAL B
 , CREDITSMGR.cm_business_plan BP
WHERE
     (C.ID = P.BOOROWERID)
 AND (V.VALUTE = P.CURRENCY)
 AND (U.ID = P.USID)
 AND (B.ID = P.BRANCHID)
 AND (BP.CREDITID = P.ID)
 AND (BP.TYPE = T.ID)
